mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over a 5-year window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary) and rise in GDPC1 (demand) create a dual signal of easing and strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous value and GDPC1 > previous value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies move as predicted, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a drop in UNRATE below 3.5% signals unexpected labor market improvement, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.5% in that regime, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over a 4-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over a 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in UNRATE below 3.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.0%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (demand) amplify market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous value and HOUST > previous value
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained FEDFUNDS above 3.5% signals higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3.5% in that regime, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 over a 4-year window.
